name: Celestial Clockwork Spire
description: A towering spire of interlocking gears and celestial orbs, each gear turning in sync with planetary motion.
prompt: A slender, impossibly tall spire rising from a misty plain. Its structure is a lattice of brass gears, copper rings, and glowing celestial spheres (miniature planets). Gears rotate slowly, orbits visible. Steampunk‑cosmic fusion, dramatic lighting, 8K.
caption: Time and tide carved into a single needle of brass and stars. ⚙️🪐 #CelestialClockworkSpire
